notes: Executive summary: Was a high-fit use case (agent + compliance monitoring) but deal stalled in procurement; customer signed short pilot with competitor for on-prem inference.
Primary reason for loss reported by procurement: competitor (Together) committed to on-prem bundle + multi-year discount and promised integration support for their internal OAuth stack.
Sales path: inbound demo (10/2025) -> POC (12/2025) -> security evaluation (1/2026) -> procurement negotiations (1-2/2026).

Security: InfoSec flagged two items: HSM/KMS integration timeline and retention controls for PII. We provided KMS integration doc (drive:/security/cedarline-security-qa.pdf) but procurement wanted HSM on premability guarantee.
Quote from Head of ML Ops: 'We liked Redwood's latency numbers but Together's on-prem proof-of-concept shipped faster and beat us on TCO for anticipated token volume.'

Technical summary: workload = low-latency chat + nightly batch embeddings for search. Throughput target ~300 qps peak, p95 latency <200ms. Cost sensitivity medium-high; preferred reserved capacity with predictable unit economics.
POC results: Redwood dedicated cluster met latency targets in our lab but integration testing with Cedarline's internal PKI and secret rotation failed in timelines they required.
Procurement objections: required a 12-month price guarantee, stronger indemnity language for financial data, and faster security signoff SLA than Redwood roadmap allowed.
Internal notes: AE raised support case for accelerated HSM roadmap (JIRA-INC-4321) but engineering gating and product roadmap meant no immediate delivery promise.

Loss outcome: Customer executed pilot contract with Together (3-month pilot, small infra fee). Procurement contact indicated potential re-eval after pilot if security gating and price metrics don't hold.

Follow-up plan: Send win/loss survey, schedule 30-minute post-mortem with SE and AE, monitor their pilot (ask for feedback after 6 weeks), offer technical office hours for HSM/KMS integration when roadmapped.
Choppy snippets from call notes: 'pricing is the tie-breaker', 'internal champion moved to another program', 'we need SAML + HSM in 60 days', 'legal asked for higher SLA'.
Action items logged: 1) Win/loss doc (owner: Maya) 2) HSM feasibility assessment (owner: Priya) 3) Re-engage procurement after Q2 budget refresh (owner: Maya).
Risk signals: champion attrition documented (senior ML platform lead promoted away), procurement conservative after cost-savings initiative across the bank.
Useful links in threads: drive:/deals/cedarline/proposal-v2 contains pricing comparisons; Gmail thread thread-17c4a2b contains procurement redlines.
AE final note: 'Lose to Together on this one — technical fit existed but timing + pricing + on-prem guarantees were the deciding factors.'
